name: QuestionCard - Choices
description: A shortlist the partner offered, as real buttons — and tapping one SELECTS it rather than sending it, so a question can be answered with two of them, or with one plus a caveat. The options scroll and the box for your own words sits pinned beneath them rather than replacing them, because every list is a guess about what you might say and the way past it must never be what falls off the bottom of the card.
